Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:10:1.hebrew: מתאימות - שיניים גדולות שקורין מיינשליר"ש, שאחת נראית כשתים:
Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:10:1.english: Double [teeth] - Large teeth that are called maisseleres [molars], where one appears like two:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:10:2.hebrew: ואף לא את המתאימות - שאם נעקרו החוטין כנגדן, לא הוי מום:
Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:10:2.english: And not even the double teeth - [meaning] that if the gums opposite them were extracted, it is not a blemish:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:11:1.english: What are the double teeth - [The Gemara] explains all of it later:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:11:2.english: And the double teeth themselves are [considered] like the inward [part] - and one may not slaughter [the firstborn] on account of them:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:11:3.english: The outer [teeth] - [those] that are in the middle of the mouth:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:11:4.hebrew: אין משגיחין - דאפי' מן מזבח לא נפסל:
Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:11:4.english: One does not consider - for [the animal] is not even disqualified from [being offered on] the altar:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:12:1.hebrew: מאי קאמר - דקאמר: "איזו תיומת? מן התיומת ולפנים":
Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:12:1.english: What is [it] saying - For it says: "What are the double teeth? From the double teeth and inward":

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:13:1.hebrew: ה"ק איזו היא הפנימית - דאמרי' עלה במתני': נעקרו — הוי מום; נפגמו או שנגממו — לא הוי מום:
Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:13:1.english: This is what it teaches: Which are the inner [gums] - concerning which we said in the Mishnah: [If they] were extracted, it is a blemish; [if they] were damaged or notched, it is not a blemish:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:14:1.hebrew: אבל איפסולי מיפסל - מע"ג המזבח, וימתין שיפול בו מום אחר וישחטנו:
Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:14:1.english: But it is disqualified - from [being offered upon] the altar, and he must wait until another blemish befalls it and [then] he may slaughter it:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:15:1.hebrew: פסח ועור כתיב - דמשמע: בגלוי אין, בסתר לא:
Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:15:1.english: Lame and blind is written - which implies: [a blemish] in the open — yes; [one] in secret — no:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:16:1.english: To be slaughtered - [i.e., to slaughter] a firstborn [animal] on account of an internal deficiency:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:16:2.hebrew: ולאפרוקי - קדשים לא מיבעיא לי, דלא חשיב מומא כולי האי:
Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:16:2.english: And to redeem - consecrated [animals], I have no dilemma, as it is not considered a blemish to that extent:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:18:1.english: And the two kidneys - [This] is written regarding sacrifices (kidneys):

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:18:2.english: He shall take it away - [This] implies [that even if there is only] one kidney, he shall take it away and burn it [on the altar]:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:19:1.hebrew: אין בריה באחת - אין בריה נבראת בכוליא אחת, והא שאין בה אלא אחת מיחסר חסר:
Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:19:1.english: No entity with one - No creature is created with one kidney, and this [animal] that has only one [kidney] became lacking:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:19:2.hebrew: הא - דפסילי, כשנבראת בשתים וחסרו, דחזינן דמקומו ניכר; והא ברייתא דמכשרת, כגון דנברא באחת, דליכא חסרון:
Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:19:2.english: This [baraita] - that disqualifies [the animal is] when it was created with two [kidneys] and [one] became lacking, as we see that its place is discernible; and that baraita that validates [it is] a case where it was created with one [kidney], where there is no lack:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:1:1.hebrew: או דלמא כו אם תימצי לומר בסעודה ראשונה כו' - דאי אמרת בכל סעודה, תו לא מיבעי מידי, דודאי לא איכפת לן אי קודם אכילה או לאחר אכילה, דהא בסעודה שניה אחר אכילה הוא ומוכלינן ליה, אבל אם תימצי לומר דלא יהבינן ליה אלא בסעודה ראשונה שבכל יום, מיבעי לן:
Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:1:1.english: Or perhaps, etc., if you say at the first meal, etc. - For if you say [that it is given] at every meal, there is nothing further to ask, for we certainly do not care whether [it is] before eating or after eating, since at the second meal it is after eating and [yet] we feed it [to the animal]; but if you say that we only give it to it at the first meal of each day, [then] we inquire:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:1:2.hebrew: קודם אכילה ודאי מעלי ליה כסמא - כדרך סם, שכל אדם שותה סם לרפואה קודם אכילה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:1:2.english: Before eating, it is certainly effective for it like a medicine - Like the manner of a medicine, for every person drinks a medicine for healing before eating:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:1:3.english: After eating, what [is the law] - Is it [considered] an examination with this, or not:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:1:4.hebrew: ה"ג: קודם שתיה ודאי מעלי ליה כשערי - שדרך בהמה לאכול שעורים קודם שתיה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:1:4.english: This is the reading: "Before drinking, it is certainly effective for it, like barley" - For it is the way of an animal to eat barley before drinking.

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:22:1.hebrew: מר דפסיל סבר אין בריה באחת - והאי ודאי חסר. ואיסתפקא ליה למורי: אמאי לא מקשי ליה נמי "דומיא דשלש קתני"? ולדידי לא קשיא מידי, דכי קס"ד דכולי עלמא יש בריה באחת, הוה מקשינן: הואיל ויש בריה באחת, והוא נמי תנייה בהדי שלש — ודאי בנבראת באחת נמי פסול, וטעמא לא הוה ידעינן אמאי פסול, דלא מום בגלוי הוא וחסרון לא הוי בפנים. ומשום האי פירכא אוקמי אליביה דאין בריה באחת, והא מיחסר חסר, ובעל כורחיה לאו דומיא דשלש היא, דהא אין בריה באחת. וכי תימא: נוקים אליביה דיש בריה באחת — אם כן, אמאי פסול:
Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:22:1.english: The Sage who disqualifies [it] holds [that] there is no creature [created] with one [kidney] - and this [animal] is certainly lacking [a kidney]. And it was difficult for my teacher why [the Gemara] does not also challenge this [answer with]: "[But] it teaches [one kidney] as similar to three [kidneys]!" But to me it is not difficult at all: for when we originally assumed that everyone holds there is a creature [created] with one [kidney], we objected: Since there is a creature [created] with one [kidney], and [the tanna] also taught it alongside "three," it is certainly disqualified even when it was created with one [from the outset], and we would not know the reason why it is disqualified — for it is not an exposed blemish, and it is not a lack within. And because of this refutation, [the Gemara] established [his view] as [holding] that there is no creature [created] with one [kidney], and this [animal] is indeed lacking [a kidney]; and perforce it is not similar to "three" [in being from the outset], since there is no creature [created] with one [kidney]. And if you should say: Let us establish [his view] as [holding] that there is a creature [created] with one [kidney] — if so, why is it disqualified:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:23:1.english: [Where] it lacked [a kidney] before slaughter - it is disqualified:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:2:1.english: [When it is] untied, [the fodder] is certainly effective for it - because the world is comfortable for it:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:2:2.hebrew: עם חבירו - נייח ליה בצוותא, ומהניא ליה אכילה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:2:2.english: With another [animal] - It is at ease in company, and the eating benefits it:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:3:1.english: In the field - it is pleasant for [the animal] in the [open] air:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:3:2.english: A garden adjacent to the city - Is it [considered] like a field or not?

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:4:1.hebrew: שיהו משולשים - לג' חלקים, שאם יראנו היום, יבדקנו מכאן ליום כ"ו וחצי, והדר ליום ששה ועשרים וחצי, והדר ליום כ"ז, דליהוו שמונים; לפי שבשלש זמנים הללו דרך אותו המום לעבור ואינו נראה, והוי ליה מום עובר:
Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:4:1.english: That they be divided into thirds - into three parts: for if he sees it today, he should examine it twenty-six and a half days from now, and again after [another] twenty-six and a half days, and again after twenty-seven days, so that they total eighty [days]; because during these three periods it is the nature of that blemish to pass, and it is not visible, and [thus] it is [considered] a temporary blemish:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:6:1.hebrew: למימעל בפדיונו - לאו מבכור בעי, דלא שייכא ביה פדיון, אלא בשאר מוקדשין שעיניהם מנטפות, והפריש מיד פדיונם ואמר: "הרי הן מחוללות על מעות הללו", ואח"כ בדקו, וקודם שתכלה זמן בדיקתו — שלש חדשים — נהנה מן הפדיון:
Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:6:1.english: With regard to misuse concerning its redemption - It is not asking about a firstborn, for redemption does not apply to it; rather, [it is speaking] of other consecrated animals whose eyes are dripping, and [the owner] immediately set aside their redemption [money] and said, "They are hereby deconsecrated onto these coins," and afterward he examined it, and before the period of its examination — three months — was completed, he derived benefit from the redemption [money]:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:6:2.hebrew: אי אמרת למפרע הוי מומא - אישתכח דחילולו הוי חילול, ופדיונו קדוש, ומביאין קרבן מעילה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:6:2.english: If you say [that] it is a retroactive blemish - it turns out that its deconsecration is a [valid] deconsecration, its redemption [money] is consecrated, and [if one derives benefit from it,] one brings an offering for misuse [of consecrated property]:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:7:1.hebrew: קרי שמואל עליה - האי קרא "פסחים בזזו בז", דהוי דבר שאין הדעת סובלת שיהו חגרים בוזזים ביזות, כלומר: אתה אינך מחודד, ושאלת שאילה כזו שאיני יודע תשובה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:7:1.english: Shmuel read with regard to him - This verse, "The lame take the prey" [Isaiah 33:23], which is something that the mind cannot accept, that lame people should seize spoils; that is to say: you are not sharp [in Torah study], yet you have asked such a question that I do not know an answer:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:9:1.hebrew: מבחוץ - שהנקב נראה, שנקבו מחיצות החיצונות של חוטם:
Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:9:1.english: On the outside - that the perforation is visible, [meaning] that the outer walls of the nose were pierced:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:9:2.english: On the inside - [meaning] that the partition that divides the nose was pierced:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:9:3.english: It is not a blemish - because it is in a concealed place:

Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:9:4.hebrew: תורא ברא דשיפתיה - שורה חיצונה של שפה, כלומר חודה של שפה ולא רחבה:
Rashi on Bekhorot 39a:9:4.english: The outer row of its lip - The outer line of the lip, that is, the edge of the lip and not its wide [part]:

Tosafot on Bekhorot 39a:4:1.hebrew: שיהו משולשין - בתחלת שמונים ובסוף שמונים ובאמצע שמונים. ובענין זה יש לפרש בפ' הקורא את המגילה (מגילה יט. ושם) גבי מגילה, דאמר שאם הטיל בה ג' חוטין גידין כשרה, דקאמר "ובלבד שיהו משולשין" — פירוש: בתחלת הדף ובאמצעו ובסופו. ושם פירש"י שיהיה מראש הדף עד הגיד כמגיד לחבירו, בין מלמעלה בין מלמטה. וההיא דמכות (דף ט:) ודאי הוי כענין זה, גבי ערי מקלט, "ושלשת" — שיהו משולשות, שיהא מדרום לחברון כמחברון לשכם, ומחברון לשכם כמשכם לקדש, ומשכם לקדש כמקדש לצפון; ולא אמרינן שיהו בראש ארץ ישראל ובסופה ובאמצעיתה. וכאן פירש"י שיהו משולשים לשלשה חלקים, שאם יראהו היום, יבדקנו מכאן ליום כ"ו וחצי, והדר ליום כ"ו כו' דהוא יום שמונים. ודומה שפירש כך לפרש שיטה דמכות (שם). ומיהו לא לגמרי הוי כי ההיא, שהיה לו לפרש שיבדוק לסוף עשרים ולסוף ארבעים ולסוף ששים, שישאר מן השמונים עשרים לאחר בדיקה אחרונה, כמו שיש עשרים קודם בדיקה ראשונה. ולא יתכן לפרש כן כלל, אלא כמו שפרשתי מתחלה, כדמשמע בפ' הערל (יבמות דף פ.) גבי סריס חמה, דמפרש "כל שלא ראה שעה בכשרותו", ופריך: וליחוש שמא הבריא בינתים? ומשני: כיון דתחילתו וסופו לקוי לא חיישינן; משמע דג' פעמים היינו תחלתה וסופה ואמצעה. ונראה דכפרים המשולשים בכיצד מעברין (עירובין דף נז.) לא הוי לא כי האי ולא כי ההיא דמכות:
Tosafot on Bekhorot 39a:4:1.english: That they be divided into thirds - [That is,] at the beginning of the eighty [days], at the end of the eighty [days], and in the middle of the eighty [days]. And in this [same] manner one should explain [the passage] in the chapter [entitled] HaKoreh et HaMegillah (Megillah 19a, and there[abouts]) regarding a megillah, where it says that if one inserted three sinew threads into it, it is valid, where it says, "provided that they are divided into thirds" — meaning: at the beginning of the column, in its middle, and at its end. And there Rashi explained that [the distance] from the top of the column to the [first] sinew should be like [that] from one sinew to the next, both from above and from below. And that [passage] in Makkot (9b) is certainly in this [latter] manner, regarding the cities of refuge: "[And] you shall divide into three" (Deuteronomy 19:3) — that they should be divided into thirds, so that [the distance] from the south [border] to Hebron is like [that] from Hebron to Shechem, and from Hebron to Shechem is like [that] from Shechem to Kedesh, and from Shechem to Kedesh is like [that] from Kedesh to the north [border]; and we do not say that they should be at the beginning of the Land of Israel, at its end, and in its middle. And here Rashi explained that they should be divided into three parts: that if he sees it today, he should examine it twenty-six and a half days from now, and then [again] at twenty-six [and a half days], etc., which is the eightieth day. And it seems that he explained it thus in order to explain [it according to] the approach of Makkot (ibid.). However, it is not completely like that [case in Makkot], for [if it were,] he should have explained that he examines [it] at the end of twenty [days], at the end of forty [days], and at the end of sixty [days], so that twenty of the eighty [days] would remain after the last examination, just as there are twenty [days] before the first examination. And it is not plausible to explain it thus at all, but rather as I explained at first, as is implied in the chapter [entitled] HaArel (Yevamot 80a) regarding a eunuch by nature, where it explains [that he is considered such] "whenever he did not have a single hour of fitness," and [the Gemara] asks: But should we not be concerned that perhaps he recovered in the meantime? And it answers: Since his beginning and his end are impaired, we are not concerned; this implies that "three times" means its beginning, its end, and its middle. And it seems that "the villages [situated] in a triangle" in [the chapter entitled] Keitzad Me'abrin (Eruvin 57a) is neither like this [case] nor like that [case] of Makkot:
